contract: Counter capability/attribution experiment only. Public sampling API exposes timestamp set; Instruments Metal GPU Counters capture exposes 31 richer definitions and global value samples. No per-kernel counter-profile rows were exported, so global counter averages are NOT attributed to our kernel and are not used as evidence of a cache/TLB/occupancy cause. Large raw traces/XML remain ignored local diagnostic artifacts; exported hashes permit local verification.
capture_commands: xcrun xctrace record --template 'Metal System Trace' --time-limit 5s --no-prompt --launch -- <screen access> <screen metallib> both 1024 4096 1024 1 3 16
xcrun xctrace record --template 'Time Profiler' --instrument 'Metal GPU Counters' --time-limit 3s --no-prompt --launch -- <screen access> <screen metallib> both 1024 4096 1024 1 3 16

counter_definitions.description: Buffer store utilization

counter_definitions.name: Threadgroup/Imageblock Load Limiter
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which threadgroup and imageblock threadgroup loads are attempted to execute as a percentage of peak threadgroup and imageblock threadgroup performance.

counter_definitions.name: Threadgroup/Imageblock Load Utilization
counter_definitions.description: Threadgroup/Imageblock load utilization

counter_definitions.name: Threadgroup/Imageblock Store Limiter
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which threadgroup and imageblock threadgroup stores are attempted to execute as a percentage of peak threadgroup and imageblock threadgroup performance.

counter_definitions.name: Threadgroup/Imageblock Store Utilization
counter_definitions.description: Threadgroup/Imageblock store utilization

counter_definitions.name: Fragment Input Interpolation Limiter
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which fragment shader input interpolation work is attempted to execute as a percentage of peak input interpolation performance.

counter_definitions.name: Fragment Input Interpolation Utilization
counter_definitions.description: Fragment input interpolation utilization

counter_definitions.name: GPU Last Level Cache Limiter
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which GPU’s last level cache is attempting to service read and write requests as a percentage of cache’s peak performance.

counter_definitions.name: GPU Last Level Cache Utilization
counter_definitions.description: GPU last level cache utilization

counter_definitions.name: Vertex Occupancy
counter_definitions.description: Measures how many vertex shader simdgroups are concurrently running in the GPU relative to the GPU’s maximum number of concurrently running simdgroups.

counter_definitions.name: Fragment Occupancy
counter_definitions.description: Measures how many fragment shader simdgroups are concurrently running in the GPU relative to the GPU’s maximum number of concurrently running simdgroups.

counter_definitions.name: Compute Occupancy
counter_definitions.description: Measures how many compute shader simdgroups are concurrently running in the GPU relative to the GPU’s maximum number of concurrently running simdgroups.

counter_definitions.name: GPU Read Bandwidth
counter_definitions.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are read by the GPU from a memory external to the GPU (potentially main memory).

counter_definitions.name: GPU Write Bandwidth
counter_definitions.description: Measures how much memory, in gigabytes per second, are written by the GPU to a memory external to the GPU (potentially main memory).

counter_definitions.name: MMU Limiter
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which GPU is attempting to execute read and write requests through MMU due to last level cache misses as a percentage of peak MMU performance

counter_definitions.name: MMU Utilization
counter_definitions.description: Measures the time during which GPU performs read and write requests through MMU due to last level cache misses as a percentage of peak MMU performance

counter_definitions.name: MMU TLB Miss Rate
counter_definitions.description: MMU TLB Miss Rate

counter_definitions.name: Partial Renders Count
counter_definitions.description: Count number of partial renders in the encoder
